cases.translation: Good names are better than fine perfume.
cases.explain: Subject of comparison is in the Nominative case.

cases.translation: The day of death is better than the day of birth.
cases.explain: After the preposition "дня" (day), use the Genitive case.

cases.sentence: Печаль лучше ___ потому что печальное лицо полезно сердцу.
cases.translation: Sorrow is better than laughter, because sadness benefits the heart.
cases.explain: After comparison "лучше" (better than), use the Genitive case.

cases.sentence: Мудрость защищает так же, как и ___.
cases.translation: Wisdom protects as well as money.
cases.explain: Subject of parallel structure is in the Nominative case.

cases.translation: Look at the works of God.
cases.explain: Direct object of the imperative verb "посмотри" (look) requires the Accusative case.

cases.sentence: Кто может выпрямить то, что он сделал ___?
cases.translation: Who can straighten what he has made crooked?
cases.explain: After the verb "сделал" (made), the complement is in the Instrumental case.

cases.sentence: В моей суетной жизни я видел ___.
cases.translation: In my vain life I have seen a man.
cases.explain: Direct object of the transitive verb "видел" (saw) requires the Accusative case.

cases.sentence: Мудрость делает ___ сильнее, чем десять правителей города.
cases.translation: Wisdom makes a wise man stronger than ten rulers of a city.
cases.explain: Direct object of the transitive verb "делает" (makes) requires the Accusative case.

reading.question: What is better than fine perfume?
reading.explain: A good name is better than fine perfume.

reading.ru: Лучше ходить в дом плача, чем ходить в дом пира, потому что смерть — участь каждого человека.
reading.question: Why is it better to go to a house of mourning?
options: Because death is the fate of all men
reading.correct: Because death is the fate of all men
reading.explain: Because death is the lot of every man.

reading.ru: Печаль лучше смеха, потому что печальное лицо полезно сердцу.
reading.question: What benefit does sorrow provide?
options: It is good for the heart
reading.correct: It is good for the heart
reading.explain: Sorrow is better than laughter, for by sadness the heart is made good.

reading.ru: Мудрость защищает так же, как и деньги.
reading.question: What does wisdom do?
options: It protects just as money does
reading.correct: It protects just as money does
reading.explain: Wisdom is a defense even as money is a defense.

reading.ru: Не будь чересчур праведным и не выставляй себя слишком мудрым.
reading.question: What warning is given?
options: Do not be overly righteous or wise
reading.correct: Do not be overly righteous or wise
reading.explain: Do not be overly righteous or overly wise.

reading.question: What is the consequence of fearing God?
reading.explain: He who fears God will come out of them all.
